scenarios.title: Annihilator N makes the defending player sacrifice N permanents when the creature attacks
decisions: A attacks player B with Ulamog's Crusher (it attacks each combat if able).
The annihilator trigger resolves; B sacrifices Forest and Mountain (or Grizzly Bears if that is all B has).
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: attacks
variants.expected: B sacrifices two permanents: Forest and Mountain go to B's graveyard and Grizzly Bears stays. Ulamog's Crusher deals 8 damage, so B's life becomes 12.

variants.label: summoning_sick
variants.delta: Ulamog's Crusher came under A's control this turn (summoning sick) and cannot attack.
variants.expected: Ulamog's Crusher does not attack, so annihilator does not trigger. B keeps Forest, Mountain and Grizzly Bears, and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: fewer_permanents
variants.delta: B controls only Grizzly Bears (no Forest or Mountain).
variants.expected: B sacrifices its only permanent, Grizzly Bears, and has no permanents left. Ulamog's Crusher deals 8 damage, so B's life becomes 12.

scenarios.title: Each instance of annihilator triggers separately
decisions: A attacks player B with Ulamog's Crusher (enchanted by Eldrazi Conscription: 18/18 with trample and annihilator 2, so two instances of annihilator 2).
The annihilator triggers resolve in turn. For the first B sacrifices both Forests, for the second both Mountains.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two annihilator 2 triggers: B sacrifices four permanents (both Forests and both Mountains) and keeps Grizzly Bears. Ulamog's Crusher deals 18 damage, so B's life becomes 2.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Eldrazi Conscription is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: One annihilator 2 trigger: B sacrifices both Forests and keeps both Mountains and Grizzly Bears. Ulamog's Crusher (8/8) deals 8 damage, so B's life becomes 12.
